x-k-k10-01.title: Ibinzana e-1, iimvakalelo ezi-2
x-k-k10-01.goal: Ukuqikelela intsingiselo ebonisiweyo eyabelwana ngayo ye-손이 크다 kwizivakalisi ezintathu, gqiba apho ithwala isikhalazo khona, uze uchaze ngobungqina obucatshuliweyo ukuba kutheni imvakalelo ihluka.
x-k-k10-01.material:
Abantu abathathu bathetha ngomntu. Intetho efanayo 손이 크다 ivela ixesha ngalinye (ayichazwanga apha).
(가) 엄마는 손이 커서 김장할 때마다 이웃 몫까지 넉넉하게 담그세요.
(나) 동생은 손이 커서 월급날이면 친구들에게 밥을 사다가 월말에는 늘 빠듯해요.
(다) 새 요리사는 손이 커서 찌개를 끓이면 늘 열 명 분이 나와서 매번 반이 남아요.
x-k-k10-01.prereq.0: Unokufunda izivakalisi zesiKorea ezine--아서/-어서 kunye ne--(으)ㄹ 때마다
x-k-k10-01.prereq.1: Uyazi ukuba isiKorea sinentetho ezigxilileyo apho intsingiselo ingesisixa samagama aso
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi intsingiselo engundoqo ye-손이 크다 ehambelana nazo zontathu izivakalisi?
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Gubungela ibinzana ubuze ukuba imeko ezintathu (김장, 월급날, 찌개) zinabelana ngantoni.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Vavanya ukhetho ngalunye kuzo zontathu izivakalisi, hayi kuphela kwesona sivakala silula.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.a: Umntu unezandla ezikhulu ngokwenyama eziluncedo ekitshini.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.a: Ukuthatha amagama ngokoqobo. Hlola (나): umvuzo nokuphatha abahlobo akunanto yokwenza nobukhulu bezandla.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.b: Umntu ngumpheki onobuchule owenza ukutya okumnandi kuyo nayiphi na imeko.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.b: Ukuncamathela kwi-(가) ne-(다). Hlola (나): akukho kupheka kuyo, ngoko intsingiselo kufuneka ibe banzi ngaphezu kokupheka.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.c: Ihambelana ne-(나) kuphela. Hlola (가) ne-(다): zimalunga nesixa sokutya, hayi ukuchitha imali ngokungakhathali.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.o.d: Umntu uphatha ukutya, imali okanye izipho ngezixa ezikhulu, ezinesisa.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.r.d: Ukwakha intsingiselo esinda kuzo zontathu iimeko, hayi kuphela eyokuqala.
x-k-k10-01.s.s1.explain: Kuzo zontathu, 손이 크다 ichaza umntu osebenzisa, onika okanye owenza izinto ngezixa ezikhulu. Ukupheka nemali ziindawo kuphela.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.prompt: Zeziphi izivakalisi apho umthethi athatha 손이 크다 njengengxaki encinci ubuncinane? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kwisivakalisi ngasinye, buza ukuba umthethi uvakala njani: onelisekile, engathathi cala okanye exhalabile?
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.1: Emva koko fumana amagama esivakalisini akwenza uziva ngolo hlobo.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.a: Ukufunda 넉넉하게 / 이웃 몫까지 njengenkcukacha eshushu, hayi isikhalazo. Isivakalisi asinaso isiphumo esibi.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.b: Ukuqaphela icandelo lesiphumo 빠듯해요 (imali iqinile) kwenza isiqhelo esifanayo sibe ngumxhala.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.c: Ukuqaphela 매번 반이 남아요 (isiqingatha siyalahleka ixesha ngalinye) njengesiphumo esibi.
x-k-k10-01.s.s2.explain: Intsingiselo engundoqo yebinzana ayithathi cala. Imvakalelo ivela kwicandelo lesiphumo: 빠듯해요 no-반이 남아요 zibonisa ingxaki, ngoxa 넉넉하게 kwi-(가) inobuhlobo.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.prompt: NgesiNgesi okanye ngesiKorea, chaza ukuba kutheni ibinzana elifanayo livakala lifudumele kwi-(가) kodwa linexhala kwi-(나). Caphula ubuncinane ibinzana e-1 lesiKorea kwizivakalisi njengobungqina.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ndithe yintoni ehlala injalo nokuba yintoni etshintshayo?
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ndikhombe amagama achanekileyo athwele imvakalelo?
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba umfundi osebenza nam angabufumana ubungqina bam kwisicatshulwa?
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.0: Kwi-(가) icandelo 이웃 몫까지 넉넉하게 libonisa ukwabelana, ngoko ukuba nesisa kuyaqhwabelwa. Kwi-(나) isiqhelo esifanayo siphumela ku-월말에는 늘 빠듯해요, ngoko isiphumo yingxaki yemali. Ibinzana lifanayo; icandelo lesiphumo litshintsha imvakalelo.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.1: 손이 크다 ithi kuphela ukuba usebenzisa izinto ngezixa ezikhulu. Kwi-(가) oko kunceda abamelwane, kodwa kwi-(나) 빠듯해요 ibonisa ukuba kubiza umntakwabo imali, ngoko umthethi uvakala exhalabile.
x-k-k10-01.s.s3.model.2: (가) 넉넉하게 담그세요 sisipho kubamelwane ngoko sivakala sifudumele; (나) 월말에는 늘 빠듯해요 yingxaki yemali ngoko sivakala sinexhala.

x-k-k10-03.s.s1.prompt: Zeziphi iinyaniso ezongezelelweyo ezinokunceda ugqibe ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwethala leencwadi KUBANGELA amanqaku aphezulu? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo.

x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.a: Ukukhangela utshintsho ngokuhamba kwexesha kubantu abafanayo, olungenakubonakaliswa luthelekiso olunye.

x-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.c: Ukuba abafundi abasebenzisa ithala leencwadi kakhulu sele befunda ngakumbi okanye banolwamvuko olungakumbi

x-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.d: Umndilili welizwe ubonisa ukuba aba bafundi bayakwazi ukuba ziqhelekileyo, hayi into ebangela umsantsa wabo.

x-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha inyaniso elahlekileyo kwinyathelo 1, okanye isalathiso esijikelelweyo kwinyathelo 2.
x-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ungadinga ukwazi ntoni ukuze ugatye enye inkcazo.
x-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba umbuzo wam ukhomba kwinyaniso elahlekileyo, hayi nje ukuthandabuza?
